Done: B25 — a finding's payload reaches the surface that must act on it. PR [#157](https://github.com/ravinald/drover/pull/157) on `b25-a-finding-s-payload-reaches-the-surface-that-mus`.

All eleven requirements discharged.

| R | What shipped |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `prompt.Issue` gains `Body` and `Unavailable`, documented in `Resolution`'s register: what each carries, and what a template renders when either is empty |
| 2 | `kickoffDataWith` maps `gh.Issue.Body` through |
| 3 | `Data.RegisterUnreadable`, set from `index.Reason()` when the read failed; `Off` keeps `OK` true, so a project that declared no register never reaches the branch |
| 4 | Owned rows render their report in both templates, dependency-routed rows stay headlines and say why, and either prompt carries the reason rather than omitting the section |
| 5 | `review.tmpl` renders `.Remand` under `.RemandHeading`, nothing when the body has no such section |
| 6 | `default.tmpl` names the section where it renders `.Body`; the `.Branch` paragraph stayed |
| 7 | Derivation moved into `localData`; `reviewData` stopped repeating it |
| 8 | `internal/kickoff/surface_test.go`: eight rows, three surfaces, each driving drover's own writer through `cmd.Execute()` and rendering the built-in template |
| 9 | Seven reverts, seven failures, each on the row that owns the requirement — pasted in the PR summary in condensed form and in full in the session changelog |
| 10 | `docs/prompts.md` documents all ten undocumented fields plus `.Remand` and the new ones, `.Path` moved to "Every template", `.Deps` row corrected |
| 11 | `make build && make check` green, `drover check` exits 0 |

Two requirements needed more than they name, and the PR says so: R7's three fields rendered nowhere in the prompt, so the run prompt now lists a weak merged dep's level; R6's paragraph could not be falsified against the whole prompt, since the heading it names is inside the quoted body either way, so the table reads the run prompt's own prose as a third surface.

## Found along the way

None of these blocks the above.

- **`run_test.go`'s unreadable-dep check asserted a proxy.** It required `"- B2 "` to appear nowhere in the prompt to mean "not named as unreadable", and the weak-dep list names B2 truthfully. Fixed here and named in the PR: the check is now scoped to the section it means, the way the sibling review test already did it. This diff introduced the collision, so it is this item's.
- **`stubPATH` breaks on a host whose `git` is a wrapper script.** It symlinks whatever `exec.LookPath` resolved into a PATH holding nothing else; this laptop resolves `git` to a shell wrapper needing `bash`, so three `internal/cmd` tests and one in `internal/runner` fail with `env: bash: No such file or directory` at `92dfaac`, before this diff. Both clear under a sanitized PATH, which is how the gate was run. Deferred: worth an item if CI ever runs somewhere with a wrapped `git`, not before.

The branch is pushed and the PR is open; the merge and `drover finish B25` are yours.
